basic_info.description: This energy-efficient home has been tastefully updated to blend modern comforts with timeless style. Key upgrades include a brand-new mechanical system with forced air heating, an updated electrical system featuring a new panel box, wiring, and fixtures, as well as a fully upgraded plumbing system. New recessed lighting has been installed throughout, enhancing the home’s clean and modern aesthetic.  This property boasts dual-pane windows, fresh interior and exterior paint, and new flooring throughout. The renovated kitchen features premium countertops over existing cabinets for a stylish and functional design.  A fully updated bonus room downstairs offers additional living space and versatility. This bonus room has been part of the home since before the current owners purchased it and now features thoughtful updates.  Additional highlights include an epoxy-finished garage floor, updated hardware and trim with contemporary fixtures, and a landscaped backyard perfect for entertaining. Recently updated by the owners, this home is exceptionally clean, stylish, and ready to impress.
